fills.researcher_notes: [GANZHOU-SOUTH-FUELSOURCE-RULING-2026-09-10] ORCHESTRATOR RULING -- ONE BRANCH, TWO SOURCES. The four Ganzhou South Branch rows (P4785 大余-信丰段, P4786 会昌-寻乌段, P4787 龙南-全南段, P4788 信丰-瑞金段) are segments of one hydraulically connected branch fed at both ends, so FuelSource on all four is 'West-East Gas Pipeline 2, West-East Gas Pipeline 3' and the 川气东送 half of the sheet's P4787/P4788 value is dropped. Sourcing: the operator's own 2024 emergency plan states the branch's sources exhaustively as 西二线149#阀室 (Dayu) 或 西三线瑞金分输清管站, in the document that names three of these four segments, and 川气东送 does not occur once in its 321 pages; the 2021 江西日报/江西发布 announcement names all eight supplied counties off the Ruijin WEP3 station with the Dayu WEP2 tie-in as the second, then-future source and 双气源双向供气 as the end state; and 全南县's own 2024 reply records WEP2 as the gas the county actually started taking at end-2022. CCXI 2022 assigns 川气东送 to the PHASE I provincial network (天然气管道公司) while these are Phase II rows (管道分公司, 承接西气东输二线气源). The order is NUMERIC convention and the live sheet's own -- sibling P4789 already reads 'West-East Gas Pipeline 2, West-East Gas Pipeline 3, Sichuan-Shanghai Gas Pipeline' -- not a primacy claim: realized-vs-designed differs by end (会昌/寻乌 took WEP3 from 2021, 全南 took WEP2 from end-2022) and splitting the value per segment would publish an inference the operator's own 「或」 does not support. THIS ROW: the two segment-level refs already here are kept and still carry the WEP2 half -- the 2024 ccpc360 bid notice bounds this segment's construction at the 149# valve chamber and the 2021 chinasei/赣州日报 article names the 大余149号阀室开口供气 work. Added: the operator plan (both trunks, branch level) and the 2021 announcement, which names 大余 itself among the eight counties fed from Ruijin. That RESOLVES the 'complication' this record's prior note logged and left open -- the WEP3-via-Ruijin reading and the WEP2-at-Dayu reading are not rivals, they are the two ends of one dual-sourced branch. Note the operator plan's four branches do NOT include 大余-信丰段 (a separate, earlier project), yet its sourcing sentence runs the branch's gas through this segment's own 149# valve chamber. --- SUPERSEDED PRIOR NOTE: Two independent, different-host sources (web.archive.org/ccpc360.com -- a construction-tender aggregator -- and chinasei.com.cn -- a provincial industry-news republication of a Ganzhou Daily article) agree the gas source tying into Dayu, this segment's StartLocation, is WEP2's #149 valve chamber, not WEP3 or Sichuan-East gas. This matches RELAUNCH_NOTES item 4 (WEP2 confirmed feed for Ganzhou-south branches) but importantly upgrades it from a system-level carryover to a genuinely SEGMENT-naming pair of sources for this specific row (the ccpc360 bid notice literally bounds this segment's construction scope at the 149# valve chamber). NOTE a complication surfaced by a third, non-corroborating source: tt.jxnews.com.cn/news/1266077 (2021-04-05, verified) states that as of that date the operating gas source for the whole 8-county 赣州南支线 chain (会昌、寻乌、安远、定南、龙南、全南、信丰、大余) was WEP3 via 瑞金分输站 (Ruijin distribution station), with the WEP2 Dayu #149 tie-in explicitly described as a FUTURE dual-source addition not yet built -- consistent with the 2024 bid notice (i.e. the WEP2 tie-in construction described there is that same long-planned connection, finally going to bid in 2024). I'm staging WEP2 as FuelSource because it is what this specific segment's own construction scope is built around (per the 2024 bid), while noting for the record that upstream of Dayu, WEP3-via-Ruijin gas may also reach this corridor through the broader network.
